title: Polish the Button
prompt:
Give a plain button professional interaction states:

- A `transition` on `.button` covering background-color (0.2s).
- A `:hover` state that changes the background-color.
- A matching `:focus-visible` state (same selector list or separate rule) so keyboard users see it too.
- A `prefers-reduced-motion` media block that neutralizes transitions.
boilerplate:
<style>
  .button {
    padding: 10px 20px;
    background-color: #4b2e83;
    color: white;
    border: none;
  }
</style>

<button class="button">Sign up</button>

tests.name: transition declared on base
tests.hint: The transition belongs on the base state: transition: background-color 0.2s ease;

tests.name: hover changes color
tests.hint: .button:hover { background-color: …; } — the state change the transition animates.

tests.name: focus-visible gets parity
reduced motion respected
